stories.title: Canadian government investing $200M in B.C.’s Woodfibre LNG
stories.summary: The Woodfibre LNG facility, near Squamish, will receive natural gas, cool it into liquefied natural gas, where it will be loaded onto specialized LNG carriers and exported overseas

stories.title: Rains ease but storm surge heads for southwest B.C., posing new flood risk
stories.summary: Deluged residents of coastal British Columbia face a new flooding risk as rains ease, with warnings of a storm surge that could raise sea levels.

stories.title: Alberta man, 19, accused of luring B.C. girl via Roblox and Snapchat
stories.summary: Police say the accused allegedly first made contact with the underage girl in B.C. on the online gaming platform Roblox before they began exchanging messages on Snapchat.

stories.title: Most western Canadians say ditching time change was the ‘right move’: poll
stories.summary: After B.C., Alberta and Manitoba ditched the time change this fall, an Angus Reid Institute poll delved into how residents are reacting.

stories.title: Shelter-in-place advisory issued near Squamish, B.C., due to flooding from heavy rain
stories.summary: The impacts of the drenching on B.C.'s south coast have been increasing as rain triggers evacuation orders and alerts, flood warnings and the shutdown of a water treatment plant.

stories.title: Vancouver Island war museum closing as visitors drop — but staff not giving up hope
stories.summary: 'Until about two years ago, we had no idea that we would be in this situation,' Lewis Bartholomew, founder and executive director of the HMCS Alberni museum, told Global News.

stories.title: Rain hammering B.C. south coast may taper, but more on the way: meteorologist
stories.summary: Drenching rain that has been soaking southern British Columbia for days could ease Wednesday— but the reprieve might be short-lived, with yet another storm system on the way.

stories.title: Tensions emerge at first Kelowna council meeting over board appointments
stories.summary: The regional district board is the only one of more than a dozen for which councillors receive compensation.

stories.title: Crown seeks dangerous offender status for convicted Vancouver sex offender
stories.summary: Gordon James Joseph Leclerc, 75, was originally charged with aggravated sexual assault and sexual assault with a weapon – a cane – between Sept. 7 and Sept. 9, 2021.

stories.summary: Watch the online news edition of Global Okanagan at 5:30 p.m.
